card.name: Unit slash after a number
card.fires_on: The unit word or letter right after a number in a rate expression, such as 'per' in '4cm per year' or 'mg' and 'g' just before '/kg'. It fires where a per-unit rate is being written.

modes.label: Dose per kilogram
modes.description: The mg or mcg unit after a number, just before '/kg/day' or '/kg/min'.
modes.example: recommended starting dose of benazepril hydrochloride is 0.2<< mg>>/kg once per day as monotherapy.

modes.label: The word per in rates
modes.description: The word 'per' after a quantity and unit, introducing a time or mass denominator.
modes.example: The moon moves away from the earth at around 4cm<< per>> year.

card.plain: It fires on the unit just before 'per' or '/kg' in a rate such as 3 mg/kg/day.
